theme: Watering a field that remembers last week
title: Watering a Field That Remembers Last Week
strategies: flat constant daily dose, ignores rain/tariff/stage/reservoir state entirely (trivial)
single-bucket fixed-moisture-target controller: top off to one flat target every day, blind to the surface/root split, the percolation lag, the crop stage, and the tariff schedule (greedy / the trap)

cheapest-repair scheduling over the fully simulated two-layer trajectory: replay the true water balance, find the first future stage-threshold violation, patch it by buying a chunk of water on the cheapest still-open day at-or-before that violation, and repeat -- this naturally pre-charges the root-zone reservoir ahead of slow percolation, skips purchases before forecasted rain because the simulated trajectory already shows no violation there, and shifts volume onto cheap tariff days ahead of a flowering-time price spike (strong)
joint optimal control (e.g. LP/DP over the full state space with exact percolation dynamics) that also reasons about waterlogging trade-offs near theta_max (open ceiling, uncovered)
